results.title: Doctors say Trump's vaccine order will raise fears, cause confusion and endanger kids
results.description: Doctors say President Donald Trump's new executive order on vaccines is misguided and likely to stoke fear and confusion among parents at a time when measles is raging, immunization rates are falling and children are heading back to school.
